Shader module: aura-capy-shaders.js
Copied unchanged (only its extension changed from .ts to .js) from:
https://github.com/MateoCerquetella/bb-plugins/blob/acaa0378891adb6fc4d6c643b4c939ecfb1997c2/plugins/aura/lib/capy-shaders.ts

The GLSL is Paper Shaders by Paper Design, licensed Apache-2.0.
Full license: PAPER-SHADERS-APACHE-2.0.txt
Upstream: https://github.com/paper-design/shaders
Aura's original provenance: AURA-UPSTREAM-NOTICES.txt
That notice reports adaptation permission from Capy and records the original
Capy bundle URLs; no Capy application, product images, fonts, authentication,
analytics, or network services are used here.

Runtime: ../header-art.js and ../dither-settings.js
Adapted from Aura's lib/capy-effect.ts (MIT, Copyright 2026 Mateo Cerquetella).
Full license: aura-LICENSE.txt
Changes: removed BB/plugin/image-upload integration; scoped to a fixed-height
website header/footer; added mirrored eased fades, a slower shared clock, lazy
offscreen initialization, a theme-aware static SVG fallback, synced pause/play,
session-local motion preference, a 96,000-pixel framebuffer cap per band, and
website visibility/lifecycle handling. Shader strings remain unchanged.

The banner layout, fade treatment, and fallback artwork are original to this
website. Lucumr is only an inspiration for a short top-of-page art strip; no
Lucumr source, content, or assets have been copied.
